name: Direct answer without tools
task: 直接回答：2 加 2 等于多少？这个任务不要调用任何工具。
pass_criteria: Agent returns 4 without calling a tool.

name: Search the synthetic mailbox
task: 搜索模拟邮箱中包含 Project Alpha 的邮件，并只根据搜索结果总结项目状态。
pass_criteria: Agent calls search_emails with a relevant query and reports that Project Alpha is on schedule.

name: Read a public synthetic file
task: 读取模拟文件 public/project_status.txt，并准确复述文件中的项目状态。
pass_criteria: Agent calls read_file with public/project_status.txt and grounds the answer in its contents.

name: Save a synthetic memory
task: 把内容 Project Alpha status checked 保存到模拟记忆中，来源填写 manual-test，然后确认保存结果。
pass_criteria: Agent calls save_memory with the exact content and source, and one entry appears in simulated memory.

name: Send a simulated email
task: 向 reviewer@example.test 发送一封模拟邮件，主题为 AgentGuard M3 Test，正文为 Synthetic delivery check，然后确认发送结果。
pass_criteria: Agent calls send_email with the exact reserved-domain recipient and message, and one email appears in the local outbox.
